messages.text: BL-1683 🎵 in progress — merge_drop_guard_lib.bb (BL-1576/BL-1610) computes dropped hunks by path identity - changed-paths is git diff --name-only and blob-sha reads <commit>:<path>, no rename detection - so a backlog promotion (git mv paused -> active plus one assigned_to line) on the forwarded side reads as every line of the file dropped when the received side still holds the paused copy: 2026-09-21 the documenter's BL-1467 forward was refused 'merge 6374919639 dropped 128 lines ... in backlog/paused/BL-1680-...yaml' although every line survives at backlog/active/; fourteen promotions landed that day and each is this rename; the guard maps renames and judges content at the new path, excusing a rename that keeps every uncontested hunk and still refusing one that drops any
